reviews.text: I had a wonderful Collagen Booster HydraFacial treatment! My skin looks amazing, feels refreshed and absolutely glowing. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Amber Easton
reviews.text: It was my first facial experience and I absolutely loved it here! Nabilah was really helpful in choosing the treatment that would best suit my skin, and Arsita did the treatment, which was amazing. Overall, a lovely experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Very good experience with May and all the team !!

Will definitely always add the Buccal.

reviews.text: I got a buccal massage and PDRN facial. Perfect combo for the skin and also jaw tension. I liked the products a lot and also bought some afterwards to keep using them at home 🙏🏼😌 thank you!

reviews.author: Rae Kenny
reviews.text: I had the best time !! I had a Purifying facial and my skin feels amazing. The staff were soo lovely and caring. Will come back and highly recommend

reviews.author: Leila Kushkha
reviews.text: I had such a great experience with Arsita during my Acne Hydrafacial! The massage was absolutely amazing.. so relaxing that I actually fell asleep :) My skin looked so clean and refreshed, and felt really hydrated afterwards. I really enjoyed the whole experience and would happily come back again 🩷

reviews.author: Nicole Mednick
reviews.text: Wow, Ive lived in bali for almost a year and had many facials, this is hands down the best I've had. Very relaxing and highly skilled staff! Loved the ai skin analysis to understand what exactly my skin needed! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Trish Sales
reviews.text: Relaxing facial - professional staff and nice ambience! Would go back again!

reviews.author: Lotus Hartley
reviews.text: I appreciate the professionalism, kind staff and great energy of the owners. Fresh, great options especially with the skin analysis. Even as they navigate new opening hiccups, especially in Bali... I will come back for sure!

reviews.author: Louis Chantoiz
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by the treatments offered! A great experience, I highly recommend this spa!😊

reviews.author: Trinette Gullotta
reviews.text: The service commenced with a refreshing beverage and foot wash. I had the Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift Hydrafacial. The beautician was absolutely amazing. Not only does my skin look soft and glowy, but my whole nervous system feels calm and relaxed.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.text: I had the Advanced Collagen Booster treatment today and absolutely loved it. My therapist was fantastic: she took the time to understand my skin and gave me really helpful advice. The whole treatment felt very professional from start to finish. It's on the pricier side, but honestly, it's worth it. I'll definitely be back!
